notes.title: The game version cannot be downloaded and started
notes.notes:
Sorry, we have found that some accounts are unable to download and start games properly. We are currently fixing this bug. 

However, before proceeding, please delete the downloaded games (Backrooms: The Exit) and download them again.

Thanks
XXE Games Workshop

notes.title: Game release delayed
notes.notes:
Dear backroom players

We have encountered difficulties in the game mechanics and promotion, and after our discussion, we have decided to postpone the release of our product - it will be delayed until approximately April 5th. But I won't let environmental designers do nothing in this preiod, so we will increase the "level!" when the game is released on April 5th! This type of level.

At the same time, in order to improve the mechanics and gaming experience of our game, we will recruit some game testers to test their qualifications through store requests and our studio's email contacts. If you really want to develop games with us, you can contact us through our email.

thanks
XXE Games Workshop
